title: fix(plugin-charts): place each y axis by the spec `yAxis[].position`, and lay out and bind horizontal-bar's axes (objectui#10654)
body:
Fixes #10654
Clause-②: no

The renderer begins honouring a key the spec already declares (`yAxis[].position`, on `@objectstack/spec`'s `ChartAxisSchema`, which each `yAxis` entry takes); no export, schema or accept set moves. objectui#10655, closed as a duplicate and folded into this card, is rows 5 and 6 below.

## What changed

**One resolver.** `placeYAxes` (in `packages/plugin-charts/src/normalizeChartSchema.ts`) is the one place a y side is resolved. `normalizeChartSchema` binds each series it derives from the entries (no `series`) with it, and `AdvancedChartImpl` places the value axes and writes the notes from the same answer. The x-side mechanism of PR objectui#10647 is reused: the `ChartFootnote` note channel (joined with `joinNotes`), and the default side. No second note mechanism.

| Family | Open sides for a `yAxis` entry | Default |
|---|---|---|
| bar (`column`), line, area, combo | `left` / `right` | first entry left, second right |
| scatter | `left` / `right`, first entry only (scatter draws one y axis) | left |
| horizontal-bar | `bottom` / `top` (the value axes run across the plot) | first entry bottom, second top |

A series binds to a slot by its spec `yAxis: 'left' | 'right'`. On horizontal-bar the chart is the vertical one transposed, so `'left'` binds the bottom axis and `'right'` the top one (the same swap PR objectui#10647 reads for `xAxis` there).

**A side a value axis cannot take** is refused: the entry is placed as if it named none, and the chart shows `p role="note" data-chart-note="y-axis-position"` under the plot, naming `yAxis[N].position`, the value, and the side it was drawn on. Not a `ChartRefusal`, no console warning, and no schema narrowing, for the reasons the x note gives.

**horizontal-bar.** Two entries now draw two value axes (bottom and top, each a recharts `XAxis` with its own `xAxisId`), and the bars bind to those ids. They were bound to `yAxisId` `left` / `right`, which the branch never rendered. `xAxis.title` is drawn on the category axis, laid out for an axis running down the plot, and the `yAxis` title under (or over) the value axis, laid out for an axis running across it.

**JSDoc.** The `yAxes` prop JSDoc and `NormalizedChartSchema.yAxes` no longer say a lone `position: 'right'` entry turns on a secondary axis, or that index 0 is the left axis.

**Docs.** The `yAxis` sentence of the `position` row in `content/docs/plugins/plugin-charts.mdx` now states what the head does (it pointed at this card). **Changeset** `.changeset/10654-yaxis-position-honoured.md`, `'@object-ui/plugin-charts': patch`.

## The rule when both entries name a side, on the four axes

Rule: each entry takes the open side it names; **when both name the same side, the first keeps it and the second is drawn on the other side, with a note naming `yAxis[1].position`**; an entry naming no side takes the side the other left free.

- **Real business need.** `series[].yAxis` binds by side name, and the docs example binds `margin` to the right-hand axis. Only a per-entry side makes a declared `position` mean the side the docs promise. `yAxis[0]` is already the primary axis the docs name (its `showGridLines` governs the horizontal grid), so keeping it primary changes no reading an author relies on.
- **Long-term fit.** One resolver, shared by the normalizer and the renderer, so a derived series can never be bound by one rule and drawn by another (the base defect in row 4).
- **Hard for an AI author to get wrong.** Declaration order is the only tie-break an author can read off the metadata, and the conflict is named on screen instead of resolved silently. A value the axis cannot take is refused visibly, never mapped to a "nearest" side.
- **No scope growth.** No key, no schema change, no new channel: the x note's channel and wording shape.

Rejected: the second entry wins a conflict (it overrides the entry the docs call primary); both refused to defaults (more notes, and neither entry honoured); index-only placement (the base behaviour, rows 1 to 4).

## Measured on the base (`4758b33`; `packages/plugin-charts` byte-identical to `02e6d36`)

A throwaway jsdom probe through `ChartRenderer` (probe file deleted) confirmed every H1 row:

- a lone `position: 'right'` entry: every value tick `orientation="left"` on bar, line, area and scatter, and no note;
- `top` on a y entry: drawn on the left, no note;
- `[{ revenue, position: 'right', min: 0, max: 100 }, { cost, position: 'left' }]` with no `series`: the left axis carried the first entry's 0..100 domain and no series, and both series were measured on the right axis (0..20);
- horizontal-bar with two entries, with or without authored `series`: 4 bar rectangles where 6 are owed (`bar` control: 6);
- horizontal-bar with `xAxis.title: 'Month'` and a `yAxis` title `Revenue`: one label, `Revenue`, rotated `-90` at x=70; `Month` not drawn (`bar` control: `Month` under the category axis, `Revenue` rotated at x=10);
- a combo with a lone `right` entry titled `Revenue`: the title drawn on both sides.

## Pin: `packages/plugin-charts/src/ChartRenderer.yAxisPosition-10654.test.tsx`

One enumeration over the rows, through `ChartRenderer` with the axes in spec shape, each row with its `bar` control. Readings: tick `orientation`, tick text per side, `text.recharts-label` position and rotation, `.recharts-bar-rectangle` count, `data-chart-note="y-axis-position"` notes, grid lines and reference lines.

- head `2fd09e7`: `Tests  52 passed (52)`, exit 0.
- base implementation swapped in (`AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` blob `d97fcee0` and `normalizeChartSchema.ts` blob `6b418617`, the base blobs; restored to the head blobs `4356fc08` / `ab7945cb` after, `git diff HEAD` empty): `Tests  38 failed | 14 passed (52)`, exit 1. The 14 green are exactly the controls; every non-control pin is red.

## Per-hunk ablation (`ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor hit as declared, blob changed, restored to the head blob each time)

Run at `f531ed9`, whose two implementation blobs are byte-identical at `2fd09e7`.

| Hunk ablated | Pins red |
|---|---|
| derived-series binding in the normalizer (back to "index above 0, or `right`") | 5: row 4 (bar, line, area, combo render + the normalizer reading) |
| horizontal-bar bars bound by `xAxisId` (back to `yAxisId`) | 4: row 5 (both), row 7 horizontal-bar, row 11 horizontal-bar |
| `valueAxisIdFor` forced to no id | 5: row 11, every non-control case |
| right-hand title layout (forced to the left layout) | 3: row 10, every non-control case |
| `yPositionNote` forced `null` | 10: rows 2 (5), 7 (3), 8 (2) |
| category-axis title on horizontal-bar (deleted) | 1: row 6 horizontal-bar |
| lone-axis `orientation: 'right'` (both sites) | 5: row 1 (4), row 10 lone `right` |

The lone-axis ablation's first attempt was refused by the tool (its replacement already occurred once in the file, so the count check failed and nothing ran); it was re-run with a distinct replacement, above.

## In-place fixes under the bounded exemption (same defect class, same file, same gates)

- **Grid and annotations bind to a rendered value axis.** recharts binds a grid or an annotation to axis id `0` by default, and a branch whose value axes carry ids renders none. Measured at base: a two-entry bar chart drew 2 horizontal grid lines instead of one per tick and dropped its `axis: 'x'` annotation; a combo with fewer than two entries drew no annotation (0 of 2); a two-entry horizontal-bar dropped its `axis: 'y'` annotation. They now bind to the `'left'` slot's axis (`valueAxisIdFor`); row 11 pins it. Without it this change would also have regressed a two-entry horizontal-bar's vertical grid.
- **A right-hand value axis lays its title out on the far side of its tick labels**, the left layout mirrored (`angle: 90`, `insideRight`), as PR objectui#10647 mirrors a top x title. Measured with the base layout: the right-hand title at x=462, its tick labels starting at x=465. Row 10 pins it. This also moves the title of every existing second-entry (right-hand) axis.

The two source files carry the same rule tally as their base blobs (`AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` 39 `no-explicit-any`, 4 `exhaustive-deps`, 1 `preserve-manual-memoization`; `normalizeChartSchema.ts` 5 `no-explicit-any`); the pin file has none. The resolved config has empty `parserOptions` (no type-aware linting) and no rule in `eslint-rules/` reads another file, so this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict.

## Acceptance notes

- NOT MEASURED: `check:doc-snippets` and `check:doc-examples` exit 2 (prerequisite: the scoped build of the packages the covered docs import). The docs edit changes one table cell and no fenced block.
- NOT MEASURED: a real-browser render. Geometry (title and tick positions) is read from the jsdom render, whose text metrics are zero. The category-axis title on horizontal-bar sits at the axis's outer edge as a vertical chart's left title does; its clearance from long category labels was not measured.
- Default-case prose left as is, true for entries that name no side and outside this card's surface: the Axis options intro in `plugin-charts.mdx` ("a second entry declares the right-hand axis"), `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md`, the `@object-ui/types` JSDoc and Zod `describe` strings, and `.changeset/7690-chart-axis-config-declared.md`.
- Entries after the second are placed on no axis, as before: they draw no axis and no note, and a series derived from one still binds to the right. Reported to the seat, not addressed here.
